name: Red Terror Martyrs' Memorial Museum
subtitle: A museum beside Meskel Square remembering victims of the Red Terror under the Derg regime.

facts.label: Location
facts.value: At a corner of Meskel Square

facts.label: Built with victims' families
facts.value: Victims and their families took part in construction

facts.label: Displays
facts.value: Torture instruments, photographs, clothing, skeletal remains

parts.text: A museum beside Meskel Square remembering victims of the Red Terror under the Derg regime. Its displays include photographs, clothing and remains of victims.
